subject: Hosted API: elevated P50 latency - status notice and mitigation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@horizonx.com>, HorizonX Ops <ops@horizonx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: elevated P50 latency - status notice and mitigation

Hi Lydia / HorizonX Ops team,

I wanted to let you know we are seeing an elevated P50 latency for the Hosted API in us-west-1 affecting shorter synchronous generation requests (single-turn prompts ~< 256 tokens). This began at ~09:40 PT and has been intermittent with periodic improvement. We have opened an incident on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20280530-7

What we're seeing: brief, platform-wide P50 elevation from ~120ms -> ~220ms for text.generate requests. p95/p99 are mostly stable. No evidence of model correctness regressions; responses still match expected outputs.

Immediate mitigations in flight:
- Enabled a temporary routing policy that directs traffic to warmed Dedicated pools for affected customers where configured.
- Deployed a hotfix to reduce autoscaler cooldown for warm-pools (limited rollout to us-west-1).
- Increased logging and tracing for request batching and kernel selection paths.

Next steps / ETA:
- We expect the routing change to reduce observed P50 within 30-45 minutes for traffic routed to warmed pools.
- Full mitigation (autoscaler rollback/patch) targeted by 15:30 PT today.

Attachments: runbook_autoscaler_patch_notes.pdf (internal runbook excerpts), incident_timeline.csv (collected metrics snapshot).

I'll keep you updated as we have a clearer timeline. Please reply here if you need a dedicated post-incident review or an executive summary for your ops team.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 11:03:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API: elevated P50 latency - status notice and mitigation

Marissa — quick internal notes as we triage:

On Thu, 30 May 2028 at 10:15, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I wanted to let you know we are seeing an elevated P50 latency ...

Observations from infra:
- Root cause appears to be a regression in the autoscaler cooldown logic introduced in the scheduler 2.4.1 release (edge case where pod warm-up signals are ignored under certain batch-size profiles). This causes more requests to route to colder pools, increasing per-request kernel selection overhead and raising short-latency P50.
- Embeddings endpoints are not affected — different handler with independent batching and no warmpool routing. Confirmed by metric checks at 10:50 PT.

Action items assigned:
- Connor: complete canary rollback of scheduler 2.4.1 to 2.4.0 on us-west-1 (in progress).
- Evelyn: confirm routing policy and monitor customer routing percentage; hold cutover if error rate rises.
- Ben: coordinate statuspage updates and external comms cadence.

I'll report back once rollback is completed and we have p50 trending lower.

Ben
Director, Incident Response
ben@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@horizonx.com>, HorizonX Ops <ops@horizonx.com>

Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: elevated P50 latency - status notice and mitigation

Hi Lydia — quick update and short post-incident summary.

Summary: the elevated P50 was caused by an autoscaler cooldown regression in scheduler 2.4.1 which increased the fraction of requests routed to cold pools. We confirmed embeddings endpoints were unaffected.

What we did:
- Rolled back scheduler 2.4.1 -> 2.4.0 in us-west-1 (completed 13:10 PT).
- Applied a targeted patch to the warm-pool signal path to prevent future missed warm-up events.
- Enabled temporary Dedicated routing for eligible customers; returned traffic to normal routing by 14:05 PT.

Impact:
- Duration: ~09:40 PT -> ~14:05 PT (P50 elevated intermittently).
- Severity: P2 for impacted hosted generation customers; no data loss; no degraded model outputs.

Follow-up:
- Full postmortem and timeline are available here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/HorizonX-postmortem-20280530 (internal doc) and public incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20280530-7.
- We will schedule a 30-minute review with HorizonX ops next week if helpful — suggested slots: Tue 2028-06-05 09:00 PT or Wed 2028-06-06 11:00 PT. Let me know which works.

Attachments: runbook_autoscaler_patch_notes.pdf (patch notes), incident_timeline.csv (metrics snapshot).

Apologies for the disruption — we understand the impact on interactive workloads and will follow up with a detailed remediation timeline and code-level fix in the scheduler repo.

Regards,
Marissa
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
